function.arguments: {"command":"cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/harfbuzz && sed -n '1,220p' ../build.sh && echo '--- maybe built binaries ---' && find ../ -maxdepth 3 -type f \\( -name 'hb-shape' -o -name 'hb-view' -o -name 'hb-shape-fuzzer' \\) | sort","is_input":"false"}
function.name: execute_bash

content:
export CFLAGS="$CFLAGS -fno-sanitize=function,vptr"
export CXXFLAGS="$CXXFLAGS -fno-sanitize=function,vptr"
./autogen.sh
./configure
make clean
make -j$(nproc) V=1 all
make CPPFLAGS="-DHB_NO_VISIBILITY" -C src V=1 fuzzing
$CXX $CXXFLAGS -std=c++11 -Isrc     ./test/fuzzing/hb-shape-fuzzer.cc -o $OUT/hb-shape-fuzzer     -lFuzzingEngine ./src/.libs/libharfbuzz-fuzzing.a
$CXX $CXXFLAGS -std=c++11 -Isrc     ./test/fuzzing/hb-subset-fuzzer.cc -o $OUT/hb-subset-fuzzer     -lFuzzingEngine ./src/.libs/libharfbuzz-subset-fuzzing.a ./src/.libs/libharfbuzz-fuzzing.a
$CXX $CXXFLAGS -std=c++11 -Isrc     ./test/fuzzing/hb-subset-get-codepoints-fuzzer.cc -o $OUT/hb-subset-get-codepoints-fuzzer     -lFuzzingEngine ./src/.libs/libharfbuzz-subset-fuzzing.a ./src/.libs/libharfbuzz-fuzzing.a
zip -j -r $OUT/hb-shape-fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip $SRC/harfbuzz/test/shaping/data/in-house/fonts
zip -j -r $OUT/hb-subset-fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip $SRC/harfbuzz/test/api/fonts
--- maybe built binaries ---
